rule: Base-model vote targets follow the cued base's own vote-over-k curve on the 328 (vote over 4 = 188.5 and over 6 = 197, result-c065a6), extended to k = 8 with the shape of the cued base's vote curve on MATH-500 computed from the stored 12-sample rows (explore half, mean over random k-subsets: 446.9 at 4, 456.6 at 6, 461.3 at 8, so the 6->8 step is 0.485 of the 4->6 step and the 8-4 gap is 1.485 times it), with intervals set by seed noise (one-sample seeds differ by up to 9 problems). An edit's accuracy at a given edit norm follows the cued base's one-sample score plus the slope in edit norm fitted on the random rank-8 edits of the same norm family on hard328 (sizes -1 to 3: 159, 158, 159, 167, 163 against base 164, i.e. flat, slope about 0); the subspace dimension m (chance overlap m/4096) is used only to widen the interval downward for the smaller m, since a fixed norm packed into fewer residual dimensions can damage outputs; nothing about the RL change enters.
